title: One judgement of the delegator supervisor
description: What supervisor-judge.sh accepts from `claude -p --agent delegator` for one case a tick could not decide by script (owner decision 2026-10-20, D15; docs/archon/supervisor.md). The judge proposes a job from supervisor-jobs.sh and names its target; it never writes a command. Anything that does not match this schema is rejected and logged.

key.description: The case key the judge was asked about, copied unchanged.

decision.description: merge, hold, recover, launch, cleanup: a job from supervisor-jobs.sh; ping: tell the owner; wait: nothing now, look again later.

target.description: merge and hold: the pull request url; recover: the run id; launch: the TASK id; otherwise left out.

reason.description: One line: why. It becomes the hold reason or the ping subject.
